facts_from_this_range.statement: James Dimon signs as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer; the source is the April 6, 2026 proxy within the FY2025 reporting container, not a December 31 board snapshot.
Stephen B. Burke is Lead Independent Director.
During early 2026, Rometty became Corporate Governance and Nominating Chair; Gorsky and Buck joined that committee, Smith and Boler Davis joined Public Responsibility.
Todd Combs resigned from the Board in December 2025 to join management; a change of executive role is not treated as continued Board membership.
Eleven nominees are listed; all independent except the CEO, with proposed service until the next annual meeting if elected.
Complete nominee roster and the principal committee text columns appear in the opening summary; other-company principal occupations and heritage-company tenure remain separate.

All eleven current nominees are existing directors, one-year proposed term to 2027; twelve directors attended the 2025 meeting. These are distinct current/proposed/historical times. Combs resignation was announced December8,2025, which is not an independently stated exact resignation day.

Burke is Lead Independent Director since2021; Bammann director since2013 with Risk chair and CMDC; Buck since2025 with Audit/CGNC; Boler Davis since2023 with PRC/Risk; Gorsky since2022 with Audit/CGNC; Hobson since2018 PRC chair/Risk; Novakovic since2020 Audit/PRC. Outside-company roles are kept separate.

James Dimon current director since2004/chair since2006/CEO since2005 are attributed to JPM; BankOne chairman2000–2004 is a separate predecessor role. Source card explicitly states both his name and current JPM title, contrary to older selection omitting the adjacent name.
Rometty since2020 is current CGNC chair/CMDC; Smith since2025 PRC/Risk; Weinberger since2024 current Audit chair. Their outside employer/advisory roles stay separate.
Each named current non-management director is independent under NYSE and Firm standards; Combs was independent only during his Board service. Audit/CMDC members meet additional NYSE criteria.
March2026 decision keeps combined Chair/CEO structure and reappoints Burke Lead Independent Director; this is an actual role determination, separate from general oversight rationale/procedures.

Five principal committees are Audit, CMDC, Governance, PRC and Risk, all independent. Current Audit members Buck/Gorsky/Novakovic/Weinberger are SEC-defined audit financial experts; Bammann as Risk chair meets the Federal Reserve risk-experience standard.

Two additional standing committees are Stock and Executive. Two currently described specific-purpose committees are Markets Compliance and Omnibus; A/B legend is specifically qualified as the committees in2025. Do not silently assign all unmarked rows to no membership.

All Firm directors elected in2025 comprise Bank and IHC full Boards, while Burke is independent Bank Chair and IHC has no Chair; these subsidiary roles are separate from parent Board Chair/Lead Independent roles.
Director compensation again identifies Combs as a2025 director with December2025 resignation, not current2026 nominee.

CMDC has no current/former JPM officer or employee members except Bammann, who previously served15years before joining CMDC and8years before joining Board. No relevant executive-board interlock in2025 is reported. Combs is expressly a former2025 director, joining management inJanuary2026. These qualifications/changes are not general compensation amounts or executive-only Vice Chair roles.

CMDC report expressly dated March17,2026 identifies independent Burke (Chair), Bammann and Rometty as its composition. Securities-plc Board roles of Rohrbaugh/Pinto are subsidiary roles and cannot be added to parent Board.

The March16,2026 Audit report names Weinberger Chair, Buck, Gorsky and Novakovic; all four nonmanagement members meet Board/NYSE/SEC independence and are financially literate and SEC-defined financial experts. The disclaimer about not professionally engaged in accounting/auditing does not cancel these qualifications. PwC independence is auditor status and stays out of C02 director facts. The21-person stock ownership group combines directors/nominees/executives and is not board size.

Shareholder independent-chair proposal is requested future policy, not an actual new Chair appointment. Issuer response separately affirms current Dimon Chair/CEO and NYSE/Firm-independent Burke Lead Director; planned separation at next CEO transition remains conditional policy.
